## Problem / motivation

What are you trying to do that's currently hard, slow, or impossible?

## Proposed solution

What would the ideal experience look like? A new GUI? A new analysis routine?
A change to an existing tool? A web-app page?

## Alternatives considered

Other workflows or tools you've tried, and why they didn't fit.

## Additional context

Sample data, screenshots, references to papers, or anything else useful.
